clarification.circuit_single_fault_acceptance: Unchanged: ACCEPT requires protected logical I and dressed residual <=1; otherwise the case must be detected HOLD/QUARANTINE.
clarification.noisy_decoder_logical_failure_metric: After the tested noisy decoder applies its Pauli-frame recovery, apply one analysis-only ideal cleanup using the frozen decoder on the residual true center syndrome. Count logical failure iff the resulting normalizer element is nonidentity in the protected logical quotient.
clarification.why: This separates protected-logical corruption from a merely residual correctable syndrome. Residual syndrome and dressed weight are reported separately.
